vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: persona-customer-support
Version: 1.0.8

The skill bundle defines a standard customer support persona designed to manage tickets and communications using Google Workspace tools (Gmail, Sheets, Chat, Calendar). The instructions in SKILL.md are consistent with the stated purpose, and no malicious behaviors, data exfiltration, or suspicious execution patterns were identified.

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions are consistent with a Google-Workspace–centric customer-support persona: it expects a 'gws' CLI and helper gws-* skills and does not request unrelated credentials or unusual system access.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (customer support: triage emails, create tasks, log sheets, escalate to chat, schedule calls) align with the only required binary ('gws') and the listed helper skills (gws-gmail, gws-sheets, gws-chat, gws-calendar). There are no unrelated credentials or binaries requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md instructs the agent to run gws commands and to load the listed gws-* utility skills. It does not direct the agent to read arbitrary system files, other env vars, or send data to unexpected endpoints. It stays within the described support workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. That minimizes disk-side risk. The only runtime requirement is the external 'gws' binary; installing or trusting that binary is the user's responsibility.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. It delegates mailbox/sheet/chat/calendar access to the helper gws-* skills (which presumably require their own credentials). There are no extraneous secret requests in this skill itself.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not marked 'always: true' and uses default autonomous-invocation settings. It does not request to modify other skills or system-wide settings. No unusual persistence or privilege escalation is requested.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent and appears to merely orchestrate a Google-Workspace support workflow via a 'gws' CLI and helper gws-* skills. Before installing: (1) verify the source and trustworthiness of the 'gws' binary and the gws-* helper skills (they will hold/require access to your Gmail, Sheets, Chat, Calendar); (2) grant only least-privilege credentials to those helper skills (e.g., read-only where possible); (3) note there is no install script here, so nothing will be written by the skill itself, but the external gws tools will run and perform actions on your Workspace data; and (4) check the skill metadata (registry version 1.0.8 vs SKILL.md metadata version 0.22.1 and missing homepage/source) — lack of provenance means you should be cautious about trusting upstream binaries and helper skills. If you want higher assurance, obtain gws and gws-* from known, verifiable releases and inspect their required scopes before granting access.
